node.statement: With that local notation, the root statement description of sigma_g as the positive coefficient mass row v places on rows at ell-1 distance greater than tau/4 from conv W is exactly sigma_g=sum_{j:dist_1(p_j,C)>tau/4} max(P_{vj},0). Substituting d_j=dist_1(p_j,C), a_j=P_{vj}, and a_j^+=max(a_j,0) gives sigma_g=sum_{d_j>tau/4} a_j^+.
